device.name: gym-ur5: UR5 robot with Jaco hand in CoppeliaSim

facts.text: gym_ur5 registers the environment id ur5-v0 with entry point gym_ur5.envs:UR5Env
UR5Env is a gym.Env subclass whose constructor opens a CoppeliaSim remote API connection to 127.0.0.1 port 19997, tries five times and raises IOError when the client id is -1
The environment switches CoppeliaSim to synchronous mode with simxSynchronous(clientID, True)
The action space is a float32 Box of shape (3,) with bounds -1.0 and 1.0, and the observation space is a float32 Box of shape (6,) with bounds -inf and +inf
step clips every requested action component to the current observation's first three values minus or plus 0.1
The clipped action is written as the float signals actionX, actionY and actionZ and the simulation is advanced with one simxSynchronousTrigger call
The observation is [X, Y, Z, F1z, F2z, F3z]: the XYZ values from getKinectXYZ and the z component of each of the three force vectors
getKinectXYZ reads the actX, actY and actZ float signals, in simx_opmode_streaming when initialize is true and in simx_opmode_buffer otherwise
The force sensor handles are built in a loop over range(1, 4) from the name pattern JacoHand_forceSens2_finger{}
getForce reads the three force sensor handles with simxReadForceSensor and returns their three vectors
The episode is done when the movePathDone float signal equals 1
step returns obs, reward, done, info, the four-value legacy Gym API result
reset takes no arguments, writes renderEnv=0, runs resetSim and prepareSim, and returns the observation only (the legacy Gym API)

resetSim stops the simulation with simxStopSimulation and raises IOError unless it returns simx_return_ok, sleeps one second, re-enters synchronous mode, starts the simulation, clears the actionX, actionY and actionZ signals and zeroes the reward and step counter

prepareSim calls initializeFunctions and then advances the simulation one synchronous step at a time until the isTracking float signal equals 1, writing the current X, Y and Z signals as the action at each iteration
The reward accumulates the negative squared distance between the Tip and TargetObject positions; step adds to the previous reward instead of replacing it
The simulation timestep is not set by this code: the sim_timestep = 0.5 assignment is commented out and its comment says the step is set in CoppeliaSim
The environment imports a module named sim
The vendored PyCopp client chooses remoteApi.so, remoteApi.dll or remoteApi.dylib by platform and loads it from the pycopp directory with ctypes.CDLL
setup.py installs only gym>=0.12.1
The README describes the repository as a UR5 robot with a Jaco hand as gripper
The README instructs opening the coppelia scene UR5-Gripper-thread-pyapi.ttt in coppeliaSim

determinism.notes: the environment exposes no seed and no snapshot/restore and this package did not run a repeatability test against CoppeliaSim, so it makes no determinism claim (FID-008 to FID-010); the cap.world.* bindings carry the Gymnasium bridge's derived 'seeded' field, which is the bridge's default and not a claim of this driver

gaps: the physics timestep is configured inside the binary CoppeliaSim scene and the upstream code neither reads nor reports it (the only value is the commented-out 0.5 s at ur5_env.py:30), so timestep_ms is 0 and a tick does not carry a declared simulated duration

the model is a rigid-body CoppeliaSim scene: its physics engine, contact parameters, friction, mass properties and noise are chosen inside the binary scene file and are not modelled or disclosed by this package; the force sensors and the camera are scene objects
no actuator, sensor or noise model: the action is an ideal position offset written as three float signals and the three Jaco hand force vectors are returned by the scene as raw values
no wall-clock pacing and no validation: realtime_factor is 0, the fake is a kinematic stand-in that was not compared with CoppeliaSim, and the model was never validated against a physical UR5

the sim backend was not run: it needs CoppeliaSim with the UR5-Gripper-thread-pyapi.ttt scene, the upstream package installed, legacy gym importable and the PyCopp remoteApi library for the running platform (the clone vendors only remoteApi.dll); the environment is registered with gym, not gymnasium

the legacy Gym API carries no seed and no snapshot: reset() takes no seed or options argument and returns only the observation, step() returns obs, reward, done, info, and there is no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: the runtime's e-stop latch refuses step, reset and seed calls until mhs.safety.reset clears it, and the last observation stays readable
